evidence: src/business/services/PayrollAuditService.ts: PayrollAuditService.constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) injects the PrismaService ORM wrapper directly rather than a domain/persistence repository.

src/business/services/PayrollAuditService.ts: PayrollAuditService.log(actor, action, subject) instantiates new PrismaClient() from @prisma/client directly (line 14) and calls prisma.payrollAudit.create(...) (line 15), bypassing both any repository abstraction and the injected PrismaService.

src/business/services/PayrollAuditService.ts: PayrollAuditService.trail(subject) calls this.prisma.payrollAudit.findMany(...) directly (line 19) on the Prisma client instead of going through a repository.

src/business/services/PayrollService.ts: PayrollService.constructor(private readonly employees: EmployeeRepository, private readonly timesheets: TimesheetRepository) establishes the module's pattern of reaching persistence exclusively through repository abstractions (EmployeeRepository, TimesheetRepository), which PayrollAuditService bypasses.
parsedVerdict.reasoning: The unit src/business/services fails the rubric because PayrollAuditService reaches persistence directly through the Prisma ORM client rather than through a repository abstraction, breaking the module's abstraction and persistence boundary. While PayrollService in src/business/services/PayrollService.ts accesses persistence exclusively through EmployeeRepository and TimesheetRepository, PayrollAuditService in src/business/services/PayrollAuditService.ts injects PrismaService directly in its constructor, queries this.prisma.payrollAudit.findMany in PayrollAuditService.trail, and even bypasses the injected PrismaService in PayrollAuditService.log by instantiating a raw PrismaClient (new PrismaClient()) to call prisma.payrollAudit.create.

violations.message: PayrollAuditService bypasses the repository abstraction used by the module (PayrollService uses EmployeeRepository and TimesheetRepository) and reaches persistence directly via the ORM: its constructor injects PrismaService, trail() calls this.prisma.payrollAudit.findMany(), and log() instantiates new PrismaClient() directly to call prisma.payrollAudit.create().
